name: Bad Schönborn (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bad Schönborn (a white fountain on blue with a red lion).
history: Municipal flag of Bad Schönborn; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bad Schönborn arms — fountain and lion
